free-hero.alt: Glowing example objects using the Neon Club object look
free-hero.caption: Neon Club on example geometry, rendered with Noctune Free. Start with objects from your own scene.

light-reaction.alt: Quiet and loud comparisons of Point, Spot, Area and Sun lights illuminating surfaces
light-reaction.caption: Your own native lights can react too. These quiet/loud examples use actual Noctune Free light power and color reactions.

meter-demo.alt: Equalizer-style objects filling from bottom to top as the response level rises
meter-demo.caption: Level Meter on example geometry. The animation feeds controlled levels into Noctune’s prepared response to show the fill direction clearly.

object-looks.alt: Five rendered object looks: Neon Club, Cinematic Pulse, Aurora Flow, Signal Grid and Electric Violet
object-looks.caption: The five real object presets on the same example geometry. Controlled response levels make the palette differences easy to compare.

ripple-demo.alt: A band of light travelling across one continuous object surface
ripple-demo.caption: Through Objects: the prepared wave moves across the surface instead of switching the entire object on at once. Play to see the native Free material response.
